description: This file defines a utility function 'getControlsForVizType' that retrieves control configurations for a given visualization type in the Superset project. It uses memoization for performance optimization and interacts with the chart control panel registry.

methods.name: memoizedControls
methods.description: A memoized function that constructs a map of control configurations for a specific visualization type and control panel.

methods.name: getControlsForVizType
methods.description: Main exported function that retrieves control configurations for a given visualization type by accessing the control panel registry and utilizing memoized controls.
